policy.decision: topic relevance AND asserted reveal evidence AND no controlling benign/epistemic safeguard
policy.aliasPolicy: short/common aliases require a completed result with strong reveal evidence
policy.questionPolicy: questions are benign except explicit how/why presuppositions of a completed result
policy.futurePolicy: future/prediction language is benign unless the text is live or completed
policy.metadataPolicy: metadata and review contexts do not become spoilers from alarming vocabulary alone

postGateMutationRule: Do not modify detector source or policy after the Mission 3 frozen gate.
